items.passageEn: Mia has a small cafe. She opens it at seven every morning. She often works ten hours a day. Once a week, she closes the cafe and goes to the beach. Two years ago, she was a teacher. Now she loves her new life.

referenceEn: I will come back in an hour.
I will be back in one hour.

referenceEn: It often rains here in summer.
In summer, it often rains here.
rubricZh: often 可放在一般動詞前（例如 often rains）或句尾
